response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(risk_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.risk_count) AS avg_count_above_baseline, AVG(tc.risk_count - b.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tc.risk_count > b.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL ordertune is an unspecified type and is excluded from the type counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL ordertune as its own group when averaging counts across types.
